registered: 2026-10-14, before any result of this study was seen
why: Owner's framework (what information could give TTI a predictive edge): test, one condition at a time, whether the information TTI's entry model uses changes the distribution of returns that follow, gross (prediction) and net (economics), on data not used to choose it.
data: HistData 1-minute bars aggregated to M5 (TTI's base timeframe), 2024-10 to 2026-09: EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, XAUUSD, SPXUSD
outcome: Every event is traded the same way: enter at the next M5 open in the event's direction; stop 1.0 x ATR14(M5), target 1.5 x ATR14(M5), exit after 48 bars (4 h) otherwise; stop assumed first when both are touched in one bar; gap through a stop fills at the open. R = result / ATR. Net = gross minus the round-trip spread in R. One open trade per event family and market at a time.

definitions.swing: fractal: high (low) above (below) the 3 bars either side; known 3 bars later
definitions.htf_trend: last closed H1 close above (below) its 50-hour EMA = up (down)
definitions.efficiency: |close(t) - close(t-48)| / sum of |bar-to-bar changes| over 48 bars; trend regime >= 0.30, range regime < 0.15
definitions.displacement: the event bar's body >= 1.0 x ATR
definitions.close_location: event bar closes in the outer 25% of its range in the event direction

events.E1_BOS: close crosses the last confirmed swing high (low): long (short). Variants: all; +displacement; +close_location; +htf_trend agrees; +trend regime; +range regime
events.E2_BOS_ACCEPTED: E1, and 3 bars later the close is still beyond the broken level: enter then. Variants: all; +htf_trend agrees
events.E3_SWEEP_RECLAIM: high (low) above (below) the prior 20-bar high (low) but the close back inside: short (long). Variants: all; +sweep depth <= 0.5 ATR; +htf_trend agrees with the reversal; +range regime
events.E4_FVG_RETRACE: 3-bar fair-value gap whose middle bar body >= 1.0 ATR; the first return to the gap's midpoint within 24 bars: enter there in the gap's direction (limit at the midpoint, or the open if it gaps past). Variants: all; +htf_trend agrees; +trend regime
events.E5_MOMENTUM: 12-bar return >= 2 x ATR x sqrt(12) in size. FOLLOW and FADE, each: all; +London/New York hours (07:00-17:00 UTC)

tests: 19 variants (E1 6, E2 2, E3 4, E4 3, E5 4), pooled over the five markets with date-clustered standard errors
pass: PREDICTIVE: gross mean R > 0 with t >= 2 in design AND in test. TRADABLE: net mean R > 0 with t >= 2 in design AND in test. With 19 variants about one in 40 design results reaches t >= 2 by chance, so the test-period requirement is the safeguard.
if_nothing_passes: TTI's entry information has no detectable predictive value on these markets at M5; the TTI line is closed.
